Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd

Enum Class CmdToken.Type

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CmdToken.Type>
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.CmdToken.Type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CmdToken.Type>, Constable
Enclosing class:
CmdToken
public static enum CmdToken.Type extends Enum<CmdToken.Type>
Defines the possible types a command token can represent. Each type is associated with a Java class and a usage string for help messages.
